driver_archetypes.rationale: Base compliant car type from Saval et al. Maintained to preserve discharge headway (M1/car) and low red-running share (M3/share/car).
Car violator type for space-seeking capacity. Params copied to match car_saval when rule is off.
Base compliant motorcycle. Share reduced to 0.76 to accommodate early-start violators and match M2/early/moto (obs 0.1466 share). Maintains low accel/decel for discharge headway (M1/moto).
Moto violator type for space-seeking (wrong lane). Share increased to 0.24 to match M8/moto wrong-lane share (obs 0.2145) by activating the rule on a larger population.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator). jmTimegapMinor defaults to 1.0s for box waiting logic (M7a/n_waiting, M7a/release_time).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (obs 0.076). Reducing p0 from 0.5 to 0.2 lowers the raw red-running probability closer to observations. k=0 keeps no swarm effect.

Targets M2/early/moto (obs 0.1466). Setting p=0.1466 matches the observed share of motorcycles creeping over the stop line in the last seconds of red. This also reduces the effective red-running share for compliant motorcycles, helping align M3/share/moto.
Targets M8/moto (obs wrong-lane share 0.2145). Activating wrong-lane seeking with p_wrong_lane=0.2145 matches the observed lateral displacement and queue-jumping behaviour.
Targets observed behavior where most motorcycles squeeze past standing U-turners. High probability (0.9) and short wait (2s) reflect this aggressive maneuvering.
Targets conservative car behavior around U-turners. Low probability (0.1) matches field observation that cars rarely cut in.
